name: External Transactor Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies a code to identify the transactor type. ||External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

DWTP.name: Digital Wallet Provider
DWTP.definition: Entity that offers a digital wallet solution enabling users to store payment instruments and initiate transactions electronically.

GATW.name: Gateway
GATW.definition: Service provider that acts as an intermediary between merchants and payment networks, securely transmitting transaction data.

IDSO.name: Indepentent Sales Organisation
IDSO.definition: Third-party entity that partners with acquiring banks to provide merchant services, recruit merchants, and manage relationships.

MKTP.name: Marketplace
MKTP.definition: Platform that connects buyers and sellers, facilitating transactions and often handling payment processing and settlement.

PMFT.name: Payment Facilitator
PMFT.definition: Entity that enables sub-merchants to accept electronic payments without requiring each sub-merchant to have a direct merchant account.

RMPP.name: Ramp Provider
RMPP.definition: Service that enables conversion between fiat currency and digital assets, facilitating on-ramps and off-ramps.

SDWP.name: Staged Digital Wallet Provider
SDWP.definition: Provider of a wallet solution where the funding source and transaction execution are separated into stages.

UPTA.name: Utility Payment Aggregator
UPTA.definition: Entity that consolidates bill payments for utilities and provides a single interface for consumers or businesses to pay multiple service providers.
